name: Filter — text
description: Branches pass / fail. Compare the source string against a value or list using one of 11 operators (equals, contains, starts with, regex, in / not in, is null / is empty, …). Backwards-compatible with rules that just used 'in' against a list.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: The text field you want to check — pick one from the request.

params.name: operator
params.description: How to compare the source against the value(s).

enum.label: ≠ not equal
enum.description: Source string differs from the value.

enum.label: in list
enum.description: Source string matches any item in the values list (most common).

enum.label: not in list
enum.description: Source string matches none of the values list.

enum.label: contains
enum.description: Source contains the value as a substring.

enum.label: does not contain
enum.description: Source does NOT contain the value.

enum.label: is null
enum.description: Pass when the source is null / missing. Values are ignored.

enum.label: is empty
enum.description: Pass when the source is an empty string. Values are ignored.

params.name: literal
params.description: Value(s) to compare against. For in / not_in, list every match. For equals / starts_with / contains / regex, only the first value is used. Ignored when operator is is_null / is_empty.

params.name: arraySelector
params.description: When the source path resolves to multiple values, which element decides pass/fail.

enum.label: Any match
enum.description: Pass if at least one element satisfies the test.

enum.label: All match
enum.description: Pass only if every element satisfies the test.

enum.label: None match
enum.description: Pass only when ZERO elements satisfy the test (logical NOT-any).

enum.label: First only
enum.description: Test the first element and ignore the rest.

enum.label: Only one
enum.description: Pass only when the array has exactly one element AND it satisfies the test.

params.name: onMissing
params.description: What to do when the source path isn't in the request.

enum.label: Skip
enum.description: Stop this rule and move on without a verdict.

params.name: trim
params.description: Trim leading / trailing whitespace before compare. Default true.
